summary: Full validation of Destinos redesign: taxonomy migration, /destinos MAX 8 cards + sort, /todos-los-viajes with 3 filter groups, Sin cupo state, admin trip_type/region selects. Backend pytest 3/3 passed. Frontend Playwright checks all passed. Test trip created & deleted; final trip count back to 9.
critical_code_review_comments: AllTrips.jsx imports SORTS from Trips.jsx which creates a cross-page dep; consider moving SORTS to /lib/tripStyle.js or a new /lib/tripSort.js for cleaner separation.
TripCard sold-out CTA uses bg-green-200 which has poor contrast against white text (~1.6:1) — accessibility concern for disabled state; consider a neutral gray (e.g. bg-neutral-300) with darker text.

In AllTrips.jsx the matches() closure captures type/region/month from React state, but memo dep arrays intentionally omit the overridden dimension. This works but eslint-disable comments hint at fragility; a pure helper receiving explicit state args would be safer.
TripCard uses hardcoded MONTHS_ES array; consider Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-MX') for consistency with the rest of the app.
FilterChip: when a chip is disabled AND active simultaneously (edge case if counts change while active), disabled state overrides. Not currently reachable but worth a comment.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_SinCupo trip (spots_left=0) to verify sold-out card state, then deleted it. Final catalog is back to 9 trips.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/trips returns 9 trips, all with new taxonomy (Clásico, Explora, Mochilero, Infinitur 90°, 4 Elementos, Altruismo, Confort, A la Carta). /destinos shows max 8 cards in 4-col grid sorted by fecha (Tepoztlán first, 2026-03-22). Sort select values: fecha|precio_asc|precio_desc. /todos-los-viajes filter testids: ft-type-{slug}, ft-region-{nacional|internacional|todas}, ft-month-{1..12|todos}, all-results-count, all-sort-select. Sold-out card: data-soldout='true', CTA is a SPAN (not <a>) with text 'Sin cupo' and aria-disabled='true'. Admin modal fields: data-testid trip-type, trip-region present at AdminTrips.jsx L146/L153. Login endpoint is /api/auth/login (not /admin/login); response has 'token' key.
